items.title: 52263_Sonny Greer oral history interview
items.q: Freddy Jenkins was a master showman. He played that trumpet left-handed, he idolized Louis Armstrong.

ctx.x: Now, what about Freddy Jenkins? We didn't ask you that.

Freddy? Posey? . Man, Freddy Jenkins was a master showman. He played that trumpet left-handed, he idolized Louis Armstrong. The first time he heard Louis, when he went to California to make the picture and we went out to Sebastian's Cotton Club, Louis was playing out there with Les Hite, Lionel was on the drums, Hamp was on the drums. We used to go out there, of course night like, we'd go out there. And Louis used to play this number, I forget the name of it, and hit the high notes and everybody in California…
